features: Product page states the NR-4000 series supports up to 16 channels per single server and up to 144 channels across multiple servers, and views 'up to 8 and 16' cameras; the per-model channel count is not stated separately, so it is left out here
Embedded Linux operating system, Intel CPU
Up to 200 fps frame rate in Full HD/HD local display
Event management: event-triggered recording, e-mail notification, video clip/snapshot via e-mail
Multi-channel playback, AVI export, snapshot during playback
Video search by date, time, channel, normal record, event and recovered file
All standalone NVRs are shipped without HDD
